name: Kiyokawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kiyokawa village emblem in maroon: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kiyokawa, a village in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 July 2009; the emblem dates from 31 March 1960.

features.role: Kiyokawa village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
